en-US: Shops: a new home with a big Sell button at the top (scan a tag in one tap), today's sales and revenue at a glance, low-stock and latest sales, and a Sell button in the bar on every tab. Fixes: first sign-in lands on the right screens; clearer message and automatic retry if the app cannot be verified.
